install: NODE_DIR="$HOME/.local/node24"; if [ ! -x "$NODE_DIR/bin/node" ] || ! "$NODE_DIR/bin/node" -v | grep -q '^v24\.'; then TARBALL=$(curl -fsSL https://nodejs.org/dist/latest-v24.x/SHASUMS256.txt | awk '/linux-x64\.tar\.xz$/ {print $2; exit}'); TMP_DIR=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$TMP_DIR"' EXIT; curl -fsSL "https://nodejs.org/dist/latest-v24.x/${TARBALL}" -o "$TMP_DIR/${TARBALL}"; tar -xJf "$TMP_DIR/${TARBALL}" -C "$TMP_DIR"; rm -rf "$NODE_DIR"; mkdir -p "$HOME/.local"; mv "$TMP_DIR/${TARBALL%.tar.xz}" "$NODE_DIR"; fi; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true; LINE='export PATH="$HOME/.local/node24/bin:$PATH"'; grep -qxF "$LINE" "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo "$LINE" >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; export PATH="$HOME/.local/node24/bin:$PATH"; npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix desktop ci --no-audit --no-fund
